title: RIVERWORKS SECTOR
description: Fictional Cold War-era industrial river crossing: a canalised channel cut on the diagonal, with a rail and warehouse district on one bank and a fenced fuel depot on the other.

data.authoringNotes: Military logistics are mixed into working industry rather than fenced off from it: military and civilian trucks share the crossing and the yards, the heavy transporter sits under a camouflage net among ordinary crates and barrels, and fuel vehicles stand beside civilian fuel storage. No spawn zone overlaps the channel.

changeDetection.summary: UTILITY JEEP moved from the east bank road into the fenced fuel depot.
